reason: Money is tight since daycare went up, and $59 a month is a real bill for something I might use twice. Add the gas to get there and I can just take the kids to the library or a free park instead.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, so $12 a visit plus a tank of gas is more than I can justify when there are free options.
would_change_my_mind: A cheap or free first visit to see if my kids actually like it, and a pay-per-visit pack or a lower membership (around $30) so I'm not locked in if we can't make the drive often.
